import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    B,k1,c3,L,C1,S1,Cv,Sv,C3,C3v = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7],params[8],params[9]
    w=0.431
    C=np.cos(w*t); S=np.sin(w*t)
    return B + k1*x + c3/v + L*np.log(x) + C1*C + S1*S + Cv*C/v + Sv*S/v + C3*C**3 + C3v*C**3/v
